exposure: Drospirenone (DRSP) only pill (DOP) 4 mg, in a 24 active/4 placebo regimen
cohort: 149 postpartum women who wanted to use a hormonal contraceptive (71 in the study group and 78 in the control group)
finding: Drospirenone (DRSP), used as DOP, could modulate mood disorders of the postpartum period in women with individual sensitivity to steroid levels.
mod_finding: EPDS scores had no significant correlation with the mode of delivery.
